headline: Central Bank Loosens Controls; Lai Cheng-yi: Hopes Q4 Credit Taps Open Wider; Chen Sheng-hung Suggests Reasonable Coordination on Urban Renewal Financing | Finance
summary: The central bank has again loosened real estate credit controls, with industry figures seeking wider Q4 credit access. The National Federation of Real Estate and Construction Developers Associations also proposed financing support for urban renewal.
why: Real estate credit controls determine how easily banks can lend against property, which affects developer financing and household mortgage demand in Taiwan.
